title: Replace acceptance meme image with uploaded image + rename/share domain to myvalentinepiku

requirements.text: Update the acceptance-state image (the at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/div[2]/img[1]) so it displays the newly uploaded image instead of the current meme image.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user clicks/taps “Yes” and reaches the acceptance state, the displayed image matches the uploaded image.
No other images on the page are changed.
The acceptance image is served as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend fetching).

requirements.text: Rename/change the deployed app/domain to "myvalentinepiku" and provide the updated share link for the renamed deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Deployment/share URL reflects the name "myvalentinepiku" (as the app/domain label).
A single updated share link is produced for the renamed deployment.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or the immutable hook/entry paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep the app fully client-side; do not add backend canister dependencies for the Valentine interaction.
nonGoals: Changing the Yes/No interaction logic or copy beyond updating the selected image element.
Adding new authentication, databases, or external services.

required: Grayscale anime-style portrait with messy dark hair, star-shaped hair clip near the right side, soft glow, halftone/dotted texture, dark vignette background (valentine-meme-piku.dim_1024x1024.png)
